scripts.//dev: Both servers as ONE job: labelled output, and if either stops the other is stopped too (-k), so a dead half is never left looking alive. A shell `&` did neither.
scripts.build: npm run build -w @endur/shared && npm run build -w @endur/api && npm run build -w @endur/web
scripts.//postinstall: The Prisma client is GENERATED, not committed. Without this a fresh clone fails `npm run typecheck` with 15 errors about a model that is right there in schema.prisma, and cannot tell them from its own.
scripts.//test:e2e: Rebuilds endur_e2e from nothing (scripts/e2e-db.mjs), then drives the real app in Chromium. First run on a machine: `npx playwright install chromium`.
